documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Quillon Holdings (fictional).
In this document "QHH" means Quillon Holdings. Quillon Holdings reports maximum service credit of 15.4% for FY2024. Quillon Holdings reports annual price escalator of 5.3% for FY2024. Quillon Holdings reports insurance cover of $10700k for FY2025 on a reported basis. Quillon Holdings reports termination notice period of 64 days for FY2025. For Quillon Holdings, the renewal is: renews automatically for successive 12-month terms.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Quillon Holdings (fictional).
Quillon Holdings: maximum service credit for FY2024 — not provided. Quillon Holdings reports annual price escalator of 4.7% for FY2025. Quillon Holdings reports uptime commitment of 99.61% for FY2024 under the original agreement. Quillon Logistics subsidiary reports term years of 5 years for FY2025. For Quillon Holdings, the renewal is: expires at the end of the initial term unless renewed in writing.

documents.text:

Quillon Holdings reports insurance cover of $10.7m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Quillon Holdings reports termination notice period of 64.128 days for FY2025. Quillon Holdings reports uptime commitment of 109.47% for FY2024 under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Quillon Holdings reports term years of 6 years for FY2025.
